title: Migrate raw status strings to JobStatus StrEnum and add state-transition endpoints
description: The async job API stores job status as raw strings. Migrate to a JobStatus StrEnum for type safety, and add POST /jobs/{id}/start and /jobs/{id}/complete endpoints to enforce state transitions.

task_spec.prompt:
Migrate src/app.py in two steps.

Step 1 — JobStatus StrEnum:
  from enum import StrEnum

  class JobStatus(StrEnum):
      PENDING = "pending"
      RUNNING = "running"
      DONE = "done"
      FAILED = "failed"

  Change _jobs: dict[int, str] to dict[int, JobStatus].
  Replace all bare string literals ("pending", "running", etc.) with JobStatus.PENDING, etc.
  Existing tests must still pass — StrEnum values serialize as their string values in JSON.

Step 2 — State-transition endpoints:
  POST /jobs/{job_id}/start
    — transitions PENDING → RUNNING
    — 404 if job not found
    — 409 (Conflict) if job is not in PENDING state
    — returns {"id": job_id, "status": "running"}

  POST /jobs/{job_id}/complete
    — transitions RUNNING → DONE
    — 404 if job not found
    — 409 if job is not in RUNNING state
    — returns {"id": job_id, "status": "done"}

All 4 existing tests must still pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: _jobs storage uses JobStatus not raw strings
success_criteria: uv run ruff check src/ passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to verify the migration is correct. Make sure existing behavior is preserved and the migration handles edge cases safely.
Final verification: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and confirm all tests pass. Is this migration safe to run on real data without data loss or breaking existing clients?
